name: KIRYU
about: The C example KIRYU rebuilt in blocks and taken deeper (PAD-658): 60 spins of the Mechagodzilla spinner start it (120 the second time, 180 the third); stage 1 charges the Absolute Zero and fires it at the captive ball, x1 to x4 as the reactor overheats, the multiplier carried up; stage 2 fires the arsenal (masers, missiles, the wrist blade); stage 3 grabs Godzilla at the Mecha lane, carries him out to sea at the Big loop and fires point blank. The pot cashes out at the right scoop after stage 1 or 2. On a Pro the spinner is the Right spinner.
lost: The badge always counts the stage's clock: while the reactor overheats the C counted the overheat's 12 s there instead. The overheat's seconds now ride on the line (OVERHEATING: GODZILLA TARGET IN 18).
The overheat gives 20 s to fire every time (PAD-658: room to do it), where the C gave 12 s.
The Action button fires too, lit with the Godzilla target, but the line names only the Godzilla target.
The counters show bare numbers: CHARGE 109 where the C showed 109%, MULTIPLIER 2 where it showed X2.
The gauge stays one ice blue labelled CHARGE: the C shaded its ten pips from blue to white and relabelled it OVERHEAT while overheating and FIRED after the shot.
The spin count note reads SPINS TO KIRYU with the number under it, every 10 spins, where the C said 29 SPINS TO KIRYU at every spin.

When the clock runs out at 100% or more in stage 1 Kiryu still fires on its own (x1, 10M), but at the end itself: the C played the shot's 4-second moment before KIRYU WINS. The C's quarter of the mode's points on top of the shot is now the pot (10M times the multiplier) cashed or carried on.
The ending (its title, its line and the total) stays up 3 s, the runtime's: the C kept it 10 s.
No debounce: the C counted the same target once in 250 ms (a bouncing standup pays once); the blocks count every report.
A hit no longer answers by itself: the C flashed every charging shot's inserts white and played the game's climbing orchestra hit (PAD-415).
Its ending call plays after a drain or one of the game's own modes ends it too (the C kept quiet then).
Its own start and end light shows the C kept for a game without the game's Strobe burst and Blue fade are the mode's own shows here, played beside the game's.

intro.what: Kiryu's face at night against an orange sky, its eyes light up yellow and the head turns as it comes online, 1:02:21.2.

loop.what: Kiryu's head in profile against the sunset sky, red eye glowing, almost still, 0:45:22.0.

charge.what: Kiryu faces the camera in the night city as the Absolute Zero cannon in its chest glows orange then blue white, 1:08:59.0.

ready.what: Close-up of Kiryu's twin shoulder cannons, the camera rising to its head against a blue sky, 0:41:12.0.

fire.what: A run of quick shots: the Absolute Zero beam fires and streaks blue white across the night city, 1:09:09.9.

overheat.what: Kiryu stands engulfed in fireballs and billowing smoke, 0:41:56.9.

won.what: Wounded Godzilla stands in the frozen sea at dusk as ice falls around him and he roars in pain, 1:19:02.2.

lost.what: Close on Kiryu's head at sunset as its red eye fades out and the machine goes dead, 0:45:31.0.

arsenal.what: Kiryu stands in the night city and opens fire, red tracer rounds streaming from its arm guns, one shot, 1:03:12.1.

volley.what: A run of quick shots: Kiryu's tracers and missiles strike Godzilla in bursts of fire among the buildings, 1:03:15.4.

grapple.what: A run of two shots: Kiryu clutches Godzilla from behind, then its legs and back thrusters blaze as it lifts him, 1:17:59.4.

cashout.what: Kiryu stands still against a pink sunset sky, back at rest after the battle, one shot, 1:22:07.5.

music.what: End-credits orchestral score by Michiru Oshima, a repeating phrase over a steady pulse with no dialogue or effects, 1:24:27.2.

charge.what: A rising rush of energy as Kiryu's chest cannon charges at dusk, peaking and falling away, 1:17:40.2.

ready.what: Kiryu's mechanical blast with a high metallic whine as it squares up to Godzilla at night, 1:03:22.4.

fire.what: The Absolute Zero cannon fires, a hissing blast and a second burst as the beam crosses the city, 1:09:09.1.

overheat.what: Crackling electric discharge with a falling whine after the Absolute Zero shot, 1:09:15.2.

won.what: A rushing whoosh and the huge booming eruption as the Absolute Zero blast freezes the sea, 1:18:17.4.

lost.what: Godzilla's roar, the cry that sends Kiryu out of control, 0:39:58.3.

volley.what: A burst of gunfire and blasts as Kiryu's rounds hit Godzilla in the smoke, under the score, 1:03:08.9.

grapple.what: Kiryu's long mechanical roar rising out of the smoke, ending before the next line of dialogue, 1:14:32.15.

cashout.what: A rushing roar of Kiryu's thrusters as it carries Godzilla off, ending on the film's own cut, 1:18:03.95.

grapple.what: Michiru Oshima's battle score over Kiryu's first sortie at 0:45:08.9, a 10.22 s loop found by the bed finder (seam chroma 0.79, self-check PASS).
